            <summary>
            An <see cref="T:Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation.EvaluationMetric"/> containing a numeric value.
            </summary>
            <remarks>
            <para>
            <see cref="T:Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation.NumericMetric"/> can be used to represent any numeric value. The underlying type of a
            <see cref="T:Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation.NumericMetric"/>'s value is <see langword="double"/>. However, it can be used to represent any type of
            numeric value including <see langword="int"/>, <see langword="long"/>, <see langword="float"/> etc.
            </para>
            <para>
            A common use case for <see cref="T:Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation.NumericMetric"/> is to represent numeric scores that fall within a well defined
            range. For example, it can be used to represent a score between 1 and 5, where 1 is considered a poor score, and 5
            is considered an excellent score.
            </para>
            </remarks>
            <param name="name">The name of the <see cref="T:Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation.NumericMetric"/>.</param>
            <param name="value">The value of the <see cref="T:Microsoft.Extensions.AI.Evaluation.NumericMetric"/>.</param>
